# Elastic Load Balancing v2

Manage application and network load balancer metadata and invoke HTTP listener behavior.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `elbv2` |
| Signing name | `elasticloadbalancing` |
| Wire protocol | AWS Query |
| API version | `2015-12-01` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | HTTP data plane |
| Selected operations | 34 of 51 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#elastic-load-balancing-v2) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No Gateway load balancers or real raw TCP/UDP forwarding.
- HTTPS listener metadata is served over plain HTTP; no TLS termination.
- No health probes, stickiness, authenticate actions, access-log delivery or capacity reservations.
- EC2 record targets cannot run applications.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
